description: Real customer TDS (retail_analytics_sets_tableau.tds) that hit beads-sigma-6o3 and beads-sigma-k2r in production on 2026-05-05. Targets CSA.TJ schema with multiple dim joins to ORDER_FACT plus 3 sets and several local calcs. The cross-element set 'Key Customer Segments' (formula references Customer Segment from CUSTOMER_DIM) is the canary — if the converter ever produces a folder.items[] dangling ref or a bare-formula on the moved calc, this fixture catches it.
